speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) whether the Ministry has studied whether the larger endowment funds held by older autonomous universities (AUs) result in differences in student educational resources, expenditure, and opportunities across AUs; (b) whether the Ministry will consider measures to help newer AUs build their endowments to provide their students and faculty with comparable resources; and (c) whether the Ministry has any measures to ensure that differences in endowments do not unduly affect the quality of education and research across AUs.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: The sizes of endowment funds across the AUs differ today.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: They depend on the ability of the AUs to raise donations, investment returns and, of course, how long the AU has been in existence.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Government funding continues to be the main source of funding for university education.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: There is also an array of funding initiatives from the Ministry of Education (MOE) and other Government agencies that AUs can tap on to support projects and research.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: The Government will continue to support every AU, both financially and otherwise, to provide the best education experience for their students.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: In fact, we not only engage the AUs at the staff level, even my own Minister visits all the different AUs regularly, especially the newer ones.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: And when we discuss, we discuss issues like these and we monitor them closely.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: At the end of the day, we also want to support them at the initial phase and we want to journey with them to ensure that it is about a long-term horizon.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We want to develop universities that can last for many years.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: And we want our newer ones to be like NUS and beyond, so that we can give the best education experience for Singaporeans.
